import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.multiclass import OneVsRestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

# Disable progress bars
import os

os.environ["TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL"] = "3"

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")  # Template for format

# Define feature and label columns
feature_col = "comment_text"
labels = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]

# Create training data
X_train_full = train_df[feature_col].values
y_train_full = train_df[labels].astype(float).values

# Fixed: Only unpack 4 values instead of 5
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train_full, test_size=0.15, random_state=42, stratify=y_train_full
)

# Build TF-IDF feature matrix
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=20000, ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=1, sublinear_tf=True
)
X_train_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train)
X_val_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_val)
X_test_vec = vectorizer.transform(test_df[feature_col].values)

# Train OneVsRest classifier
model = OneVsRestClassifier(
    LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, multi_class="ovr", solver="lbfgs"), n_jobs=-1
)
model.fit(X_train_vec, y_train)

# Get probability predictions on validation set
y_prob_val = model.predict_proba(X_val_vec)
valid_roc_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_prob_val, average=None)

# Print validation metrics
print("\nColumn-wise ROC AUC Scores on Hold-out Validation:")
for i, label in enumerate(labels):
    print(f"{label}: {valid_roc_auc[i]:.4f}")
mean_auc = np.mean(valid_roc_auc)
print(f"\nMean Column-wise ROC AUC: {mean_auc:.4f}")

# Generate predictions on test set
y_prob_test = model.predict_proba(X_test_vec)

# Create submission dataframe matching sample format
submission_df = sample_sub.copy()
for i, label in enumerate(labels):
    submission_df[label] = y_prob_test[:, i]

# Save to submission directory
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("\nSubmission file saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
